 PARIVISION picked the Ancient they had won twice in Beijing and left it with two rounds, and MOUZ go straight to the semi-finals without dropping a map. 
 MOUZ won Group B of IEM Beijing 2026 on Wednesday morning with a 2-0 win over PARIVISION in the upper bracket final, 13-2 on Ancient and 13-9 on Mirage. MOUZ skip the quarter-finals and play their semi-final on 7 November, while PARIVISION have one more series to play on Friday.

 Without losing a single map, we‘re moving from the basement to the semi finals.
See you on stage 🫡 pic.twitter.com/2jDldQQYCi 
— MOUZ (@mousesports) November 4, 2026 Eleven rounds in a row on Ancient
 Ancient was the map PARIVISION trusted most. They had won 10 of their 13 maps there over the last three months, including 13-9 against G2 and 13-7 against Liquid earlier in the event, while MOUZ had won only half of their eight. PARIVISION picked it, MOUZ let it through. It was a rout.
 Advertisement It started well enough for PARIVISION on the T side. They won the pistol round, and in the fourth round Abay “HObbit” Khassenov won a 1v1 against Ádám “torzsi” Torzsás with almost no health left to make it 2-2. That was the last round they won for a long time. MOUZ took the next eight to lead 10-2 at the half, and PARIVISION had used two timeouts by then.
 One round summed it up. Lotan “Spinx” Giladi and PR were left 2v4 with barely any health between them, held their positions and won it. Spinx then opened the second half with four kills on the pistol round, and MOUZ added the last three rounds without reply. The Israeli finished the map 18-6 with 129.5 ADR and 100% KAST, while zweih went 1-14.
 A late pulse on Mirage
 MOUZ’s own Mirage pick looked like more of the same for a half. PARIVISION won the pistol round, then torzsi took over with the AWP, including a four-kill round in which he pushed up close into Ticket. It was 9-3 at the break.
 The second half was the contest the first map never became. PARIVISION won the pistol round and the three after it, with Jame finally landing shots with the AWP, and got to 7-9. xelex and PR stopped the run.
 W duo @xelexcs @PRcsgoo 👊 #IEM pic.twitter.com/m6uERh1n10 
— ESL Counter-Strike (@ESLCS) November 4, 2026 With MOUZ at 11-7 and no money left, PARIVISION spent their last timeout and bought Tec-9s. HObbit planted on B, hid in the site and held off the retake on his own in a 1v2 to make it 8-11.
 . @HObbitcsgo scares the mice off the defuse 😰 #IEM pic.twitter.com/TEIKqlPHnC 
— ESL Counter-Strike (@ESLCS) November 4, 2026 The comeback stopped there. MOUZ won two of the last three rounds to close it out at 13-9, and xelex ended Mirage 22-13 with 96.0 ADR.
 Six maps from six
 MOUZ have now won every map they have played in Beijing: Inferno and Nuke against TYLOO, Ancient and Mirage against BetBoom, and these two. Four of their five players finished the series between +8 and +16, and torzsi, at 30-16 with 86.5% KAST, was HLTV’s player of the match.
 Advertisement For PARIVISION the numbers turned upside down. FL1T was the best player on the server against Liquid on Tuesday with 36-22, and here went 14-30. zweih finished 9-27.
 They still have a route to the title. PARIVISION play a quarter-final on Friday, and MOUZ wait for their semi-final opponent on Saturday. We follow the playoffs on our IEM Beijing 2026 page .
 Author Anders Frost
 A lifelong gamer with 21 years on Steam, first introduced to Counter-Strike in 1.6 but truly hooked by CS:GO. Loves the idea of playing AWP - just not quite skilled enough to pull it off. Outside the server, a journalist with 14 years of experience covering both traditional sports and esports.
